title: Drop Screen Occluder
name: drop_screen_occluder
description: A ball rolls at a constant speed along a straight rail from left to right. A solid opaque screen, held in vertical guides in front of the rail, drops straight down from above to fully block the view of the ball's mid-path and holds there while the ball passes hidden behind it; the screen then lifts back up and the ball is revealed on the far side, unchanged and still moving at the same steady speed. The ball never stops, reappearing at a position consistent with continuous constant-velocity motion.
